name: Andre Lyver
headline: VP Shopify Professional Services; previously: Director of Product, ShopifyFinancial Solutions (Payments,Risk, Banking. Billing); Director of Engineering (Payments & Capital), Angel Investor; Mentor, Advisor
about:
Andre Lyver is the VP and Head of Professional Services at Shopify, with 24 years in commerce and payments technology. He has led teams across startups and global enterprises, building high‑availability commerce platforms, transaction processing systems, and fintech products. At Shopify, Andre founded Professional Services, a revenue‑generating consulting division that helps the world’s largest brands implement, optimize, and scale on Shopify.

His team has launched hundreds of enterprise customers and driven billions in GMV, with a focus on speed to market, performance, and measurable outcomes. Previously, Andre led Shopify’s Financial Services division, overseeing Payments, Capital, Balance, and Risk Management, scaling financial products used by millions of customers worldwide.
… more

experiences.description:
I lead the team that helps enterprise brands implement, optimize, scale and innovate on Shopify: navigating technical challenges, reducing risk, compressing time to launch, and improving performance and conversion.

Professional Services consists of Engagement Managers, Solutions Architects, Web Performance Engineers, Program Managers and Software Engineers, who are uniquely positioned to consult, access or unlock Shopify capabilities which enable strategic merchants and partners to succeed.

Highlights
- Launched hundreds of enterprise customers, representing billions in GMV
- Drove speed and time-to-launch for some of the world’s largest brands
- Built a revenue-generating services and technical consulting division inside Shopify.
- Touched every enterprise migration to Shopify across industries, partners, and products

Founded the Professional Services team to help guide our largest brands and customers through their Shopify implementations with speed and confidence.  I built the foundations, defined the services portfolio, set the delivery model, and hired the core leaders and specialists. We experimented with our services,  learned what did and didn't, and turned the lessons into repeatable playbooks. We earned our first enterprise customers and shipped early launches, setting the standard for future work and growth.

experiences.position: Director, Fraud and Risk Management (Code Yellow)
experiences.description: Led the team aiming and assembly, and oversaw the implementation of mitigations to address high profile and high impact fraud and risk management concerns. Areas of focus included operational efficiencies within existing Fraud and Risk Management analyst teams, new research and development initiatives in the area of Machine Learning and online inference, and the implementation of a new centralized Trust Platform within Shopify, used to provide a holistic merchant view across the platform, and to minimize the impact of bad actors.

Responsible for R&D (Product, Engineering and UX) of Shopify’s entire Financial Solutions division,  overseeing initiatives across the entire product portfolio: Payments, Capital, Risk Management, Billing & Financial Reconciliation, Merchant Balance, and Merchant Sales Tax.

Responsible for driving the strategy and execution of Shopify’s entire Financial Solutions division,  including Business Development, Partnerships, Product Management, Engineering and UX teams in the areas of Payments, Capital, Risk Management, Billing & Financial Reconciliation, and Merchant Balance.

experiences.position: Director of Engineering - Payments and Capital
experiences.description: Led the architecture, engineering, and maintenance of industry leading payments and related financial technology systems that supports Shopify’s merchants, partners and customers.
